notes.title: How to get a supercar
notes.content:
Good day, drivers.



Here's how to get a cool supercar in the game.




[previewyoutube=3IT7Kv4JGlk;full][/previewyoutube]
Step 1: You need 3,000,000 R$ to purchase the Supercar & Penthouse.

Step 2: You may obtain Crypto Water, a unique resource, during your journey – if today happens to be your lucky day.

Step 3: Once you've acquired the Water, head to the Black Market. You'll be automatically directed there after hitting the guys or reaching your home, provided you possess the Water. Alternatively, you can store the Water instead of selling it. The market price of Water fluctuates, and you can also access the Black Market in the Menus Scene.

Step 4: Visit the shop and buy the Supercar & Penthouse once you've earned 3,000,000 R$ by selling the Water.

Step 5: Your purchased supercar will be waiting for you in your garage.

Step 6: Get in and start the engine.





Thank you for your interest in The Way Home.

We hope you make it home safely, without any accidents. Always stay happy and take care.



Cheers,
The Way Home Team

notes.title: Information about frame optimization before starting the drive
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40537219/c1de66f939bb3c97e235492bc9639cbba3ca65ee.gif[/img]﻿

Good to see you, drivers.


We're excited to greet you for the first time. It's a pleasure to meet you.


We've put in several rounds of testing to ensure your driving experience is as smooth as possible. However, with all the different devices out there, the default graphics settings might not be a perfect fit for everyone, and you could experience some lag or glitches while driving. (Frame freezing)

So, we wanted to give you a heads up on the default graphics settings:


1. FPS is fixed at 60 (can't be modified).
2. vSync is turned on.


If you're feeling a bit buggy or laggy, consider adjusting vSync in the settings menu. Especially in a fast-paced Racing game, turning on vSync might be the way to go.

Also, to keep your frames smooth, you might want to try turning off cloud movement in the settings menu if you're experiencing stuttering frames.


[previewyoutube=MQY70z4xkdo;full][/previewyoutube]
If you're having trouble figuring out these settings from the image alone, check out this video tutorial.



Thanks for showing interest in The Way Home. Hope you make it home without any accidents.

Have a great day and take care.


Cheers,
The Way Home Team
